description: [Requires YOUTUBE_API_KEY] Retrieve comment threads for a YouTube video with explicit pagination and plain-text evidence. Use includeReplies for the provider-embedded reply subset, completeReplies for bounded comments.list pagination (100 replies/thread by default, maximum 1000). Each call allows at most 1000 replies, 20 reply requests and 1 MiB of reply JSON; inspect replyCoverage for incomplete or truncated results. Use maxRepliesPerThread for a per-thread cap, searchTerms for source-native comment filtering, and pageToken for the next top-level thread page.
name: get-video-comments
